title: Hold a licence to keep dangerous substances
what: Keep prescribed dangerous substances (such as flammable liquids or gases above set quantities) on premises only under a licence.

sources.title: Dangerous Substances Act 1979 (SA)
sources.publisher: South Australian Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not keep a prescribed dangerous substance in any premises unless the person is the holder of a licence under this Division
